title: Salman Khan Eyed for Cop Role Opposite Sanjay Dutt in Khalnayak Returns
excerpt: Mid-Day reports Subhash Ghai's writers are building a good-Samaritan police officer around Salman for the Khalnayak sequel — but Ghai says scripting is still on and nothing is locked.
body:
• Salman Khan is being considered for a police officer's role in Khalnayak Returns, the sequel to Subhash Ghai's 1993 hit Khalnayak, according to a Mid-Day report carried by Bollywood Hungama on October 30.
  • The character — a good-Samaritan cop who helps Sanjay Dutt's Ballu — is being written with Salman in mind, but casting is not locked and the script is still being developed.
  • Ghai himself declined to confirm anything: "It's too early to say anything. The scripting is still on."
  • If it happens, it would be Salman's first film with Ghai since Yuvvraaj (2008) and his third with Dutt, after Saajan (1991) and Chal Mere Bhai (2000).

Salman Khan could reunite with Sanjay Dutt on screen in Khalnayak Returns — as the policeman, not the outlaw. According to a report by Mid-Day carried by Bollywood Hungama on October 30, filmmaker Subhash Ghai and the sequel's writing team are developing a police officer's character with Salman in mind. His involvement is not confirmed: the film is still in the scripting stage, and no casting is locked.

"The role impacts the narrative. The idea is that the cop, a good Samaritan, will help Sanjay's character. Who better than Salman to play this helpful character? The casting is not locked yet as the script is still being developed."

— Insider source, quoted by Mid-Day

What Is Settled, and What Is Not

The sequel itself is real: Dutt announced Khalnayak Returns earlier this year and is set to return as Ballu, the anti-hero he played in the 1993 original opposite Jackie Shroff and Madhuri Dixit. Jackie Shroff is also confirmed for the sequel, this time as police commissioner Ram rather than the inspector he played in the original, MensXP reported. Ghai, who directed the original, is involved as a creative force on the sequel, which is being produced by Dutt's Three Dimension Motion Pictures and Aksha Kamboj's Aspect Entertainment, according to iDiva. Salman's part is the unsettled piece.

Asked about the reports, Ghai told Mid-Day: "It's too early to say anything. The scripting is still on, and once we have a complete script, we will know where we stand." The makers are expected to take a final call once the screenplay is ready.

Why the Pairing Draws Attention

Salman and Dutt are two of the defining stars of 1990s Hindi cinema, yet they have shared the screen rarely: Saajan in 1991 and Chal Mere Bhai in 2000 are their major collaborations. A reunion inside a Khalnayak sequel — with Dutt reprising Ballu and Salman potentially playing the officer who helps him — inverts the cat-and-mouse casting audiences would expect. It would also be Salman's second film with Ghai, 18 years after Yuvvraaj in 2008.

What to Watch Next

Everything now depends on the finished script and Ghai's promised final call. Salman's next confirmed release is Maatrubhumi: May War Rest in Peace, so even a signed Khalnayak Returns would queue behind it. Until the makers announce casting officially, this remains what Ghai says it is: a script still being written, with a cop's uniform waiting for an actor who has not yet said yes.
